analyzed_vuln.description: Heap OOB read in ebitmap_match_any() is caused by out-of-bounds indexing into pdb->attr_type_map in check_assertion_avtab_match(). The root cause is in cil_typeattribute_to_bitmap(): it iterates bits from cil_attr->types and uses db->val_to_type[i] without validating that i is within valid type-value bounds (or that the mapped datum/value is valid). This can populate inconsistent type/attribute bitmaps and later produce invalid source/target type values used as k->source_type/k->target_type, so check_assertion_avtab_match reads p->attr_type_map[k->source_type-1] from before the allocated array, leading to the ASan crash at ebitmap_match_any.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Fuzzed CIL input must create malformed/inconsistent typeattribute/typeattributeset state (via cil_attr->types bit positions) so cil_typeattribute_to_bitmap processes an invalid bit index i and builds corrupted attr/type mapping. During neverallow checking (cil_check_neverallow -> check_assertion -> avtab_map -> check_assertion_avtab_match), an avtab entry with invalid source/target type value then indexes attr_type_map with (type-1) out of range, and ebitmap_match_any dereferences the resulting invalid ebitmap node pointer, triggering the heap-buffer-overflow read.
